# LAMMPS Input Script for Melting Silicon

units metal
atom_style full
boundary p p p

read_data silicon.data

# Replicate the structure
replicate 3 3 3

# Define interatomic potential
pair_style sw
pair_coeff * * /potentials/Si.sw Si

# Define settings for NPT ensemble
fix 1 all npt temp 300.0 2500.0 454.545 iso 0.0 0.0 1000.0

timestep 1.0
thermo 1000
thermo_style custom step temp press density

# Run the heating process
run 100000

# Equilibrate at 2500K
unfix 1
fix 2 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 1000.0 iso 0.0 0.0 1000.0
run 500000

# Compute MSD for diffusion coefficient
compute msd all msd
fix 3 all ave/time 100 1 100 c_msd[4] file msd.txt mode vector

# Run for additional time to gather MSD data
run 500000

# LAMMPS Input Script for Melting Silicon

units metal
atom_style full
boundary p p p

# Read data file
read_data silicon.data

# Replicate the structure
replicate 3 3 3

# Define interatomic potential
pair_style sw

neigh_modify delay 5

# Define thermodynamic output

fix 2 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 100.0 iso 0.0 0.0 1000.0
run 500000 # Equilibration for 500 ps

# Compute MSD for diffusion coefficient
compute msd all msd
fix 3 all ave/time 100 1 100 c_msd[4] file msd.txt mode vector

# Run for additional time to gather MSD data
run 500000

# End of script
